newsitem.title: FINLAND: FINNISH AUG NEW PRIVATE CAR SALES UP 27 PCT-BRANCH.
newsitem.headline: FINNISH AUG NEW PRIVATE CAR SALES UP 27 PCT-BRANCH.

text.p: Finnish new private car regustrations increased 26.6 percent year-on-year in August to 7,217 cars, the Information Centre of the Automobile Branch said in a statement on Thursday.
In January-August, new private car sales increased 21.5 percent to 58,402 cars, it said.
Car dealers raised their forecast for full-year 1996 sales of private cars to about 95,000 from an earlier forecast of around 87,000, it said.
